name: star-systems-demo-server
description: MCP Apps server: 1P FTL exploration of the local stellar neighborhood with LLM-narrated celestial bodies. Cockpit + compendium + log panes.

scripts.build:panes: npm run build:cockpit && npm run build:compendium && npm run build:bridge && npm run build:overview && npm run build:targetinfo
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && npm run build:panes
scripts.start: concurrently --raw "cross-env NODE_ENV=development INPUT=cockpit.html vite build --watch" "cross-env NODE_ENV=development INPUT=compendium.html vite build --watch" "cross-env NODE_ENV=development INPUT=bridge.html vite build --watch" "cross-env NODE_ENV=development INPUT=overview.html vite build --watch" "cross-env NODE_ENV=development INPUT=target-info.html vite build --watch" "tsx watch main.ts"
